item.title: Meet Doddy, the AI agent that remembers what you tell it
item.description: AI agents are everywhere in 2026. Doddy is a friendlier, smaller one: an iPhone assistant you talk to, that keeps your notes in your own words and asks before it does anything. Here's what it can do, what it can't, and how we keep it safe.

item.title: Hello, Doddy: why our favourite first result was “I couldn’t find it”
item.description: Doddy is a hand-drawn mate for your iPhone that keeps the small things you ask it to keep. In its first real conversations it couldn't find a note, and said so. Here's why that matters, and what we fixed.
